title: Zoom in: counting plays in event-time windows
caption: A play lands in the window of its start time. Short lateness is absorbed in the stream; plays that arrive hours late are counted by the nightly recompute.

messages.label: play p7: track t3 @ 21:05:40, 95 s
messages.note: One event per play, sent when it ends: start time and seconds listened come from the device.

messages.label: p7 → window (t3, SE, 21:05)
messages.note: 95 s ≥ 30 s, so it counts. The window comes from the start time, not the arrival time.

messages.label: p7 not seen yet → count
messages.note: Play ids seen are kept with the window, so a repeat is dropped.

messages.label: watermark passes 21:06 + 3 min
messages.note: The allowed lateness covers slow networks, not phones that were offline for hours.

messages.label: ack
messages.note: Only now is the window state dropped and the checkpoint advanced.

scenarios.name: Offline phone
scenarios.summary: A listener on a long flight plays an album offline and syncs six hours later. The stream can't count those plays, but the final numbers do.

messages.label: offline: buffer 11 plays
messages.note: Start times are around 14:00; the device keeps them until it has a connection.

messages.label: sink: the raw events are kept
side output: late plays +11
messages.note: A late-plays metric; the streaming minute rows stay a little low.

messages.label: nightly recon: day row recomputed
messages.note: The final day row includes the 11 plays, and royalties are paid from it.

scenarios.name: Retried upload
scenarios.summary: The phone never sees the ack and sends the same batch again. Dedup by play id keeps the play counted once.

messages.label: ack
messages.note: The connection drops before the ack arrives.

messages.label: p7 already seen → drop
messages.note: Recon also dedups by play id, so the raw archive's two copies count once too.

scenarios.name: Skipped at 12 s
scenarios.summary: A listener skips after 12 seconds. The event is kept, but it is not a play and earns no royalty.

messages.label: sink: kept for recon and analysis
p10 below 30 s
messages.note: Counted as a skip, a separate metric, not as a play.

messages.label: upsert (t4, SE, 21:05) skips = 1
messages.note: Recon applies the same 30 s rule, so the stream and the final numbers agree.
